post.originalText:
OPUS BUILT THE BEST CAR. IT NEVER FINISHED.

same prompt to 4 agents: build a 3d car configurator from scratch. no prebuilt 3d models. 40 min cap.

opus 5.5 → $5.76, timed out
sonnet 5.5 → $2.12, 33 min
codex sol 6.1 → $0.83, 35 min
haiku 5.5 → $0.38, 17 min

cheapest and fastest wasn't the best-looking. best-looking didn't finish.

which one would you ship?

sourceMaterials.text: @rbsriram that's the pick i'd make too. sonnet's car did have glitches though, white patches on the roof. sonnet + 2 fix rounds vs one opus run is a fair fight, might actually run that next
